environment.description: AWS Lambda authorizer running in account 111222333444, Node.js 18.x runtime. The Lambda execution role has sts:AssumeRole permission on the ADMIN_ROLE_ARN (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/AdminOperationsRole). The AdminOperationsRole trust policy allows the Lambda role to assume it. No SCPs applied to the account (standalone account, not in AWS Organizations). No permission boundaries on the Lambda execution role. The JWT_PUBLIC_KEY environment variable contains the RSA public key in PEM format.
